existingFixParts.note: Right-hand (A-bank) camshaft cover gasket for the 4.2 AJ-V8. Confirmed fitment XK/XKR 4.2 2007-2009 (also S-Type/XJ/XF 4.2 and X100 XK8/XKR). Supersedes older AJ82873/AJ86868. Genuine OE strongly advised - aftermarket gaskets are widely reported to re-leak. OEM ~$60-75, quality aftermarket (Elring/U
existingFixParts.component: Cam (valve) cover gasket - RIGHT/A bank

existingFixParts.note: Left-hand (B-bank) camshaft cover gasket, mirror of AJ812399. Confirmed fitment XK/XKR 4.2 2007-2009 (also S-Type/XJ8/XJR/XF 4.2). Both banks should be done together as a set. Genuine OE recommended over aftermarket which is reported to weep. ~$40-72 typical.
existingFixParts.component: Cam (valve) cover gasket - LEFT/B bank

existingFixParts.note: Rubber isolator grommet/seal under each cam-cover retaining bolt - these harden and are a primary weep path, so replace with the gasket. 14 per cover / 28 per engine. Fits 1997-2009 4.0/4.2 V8 XK8/XK/XJ8/S-Type (covers 2007-2009 XK). Price is per grommet.
existingFixParts.component: Cam cover bolt grommet / isolator seal (rubber)

existingFixParts.note: Seals the cam-cover spark-plug tube boss - failure lets oil pool in the plug wells and foul coils/cause misfires (the exact symptom described). 8 required per engine. Confirmed fitment XK/XKR 4.2 2007-2009 (3.5L+4.2L V8 S-Type/XJ/XK8/XF). Replace while covers are off. Price per seal.

existingFixParts.note: XR821244 is the genuine Jaguar differential output/assembly seal, fits 2003-2009 (both LH and RH output). A leaking near-side output seal is the classic early tell; replacing it promptly preserves the unit. Cheap consumable - buy two (both sides).
